input.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying for the Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer role at Plato. After reviewing your application we've determined that there isn't an ideal fit at this time, and we will not be moving forward with your candidacy.

We appreciate your interest in Plato!

All the best,

Plato Hiring Team
